name: Ichi
author: Henri Eskelinen
description: One window, room to breathe. When a workspace holds a single window, Ichi keeps it from sprawling: a percentage of the screen or an aspect ratio, per workspace, adjustable live. The window stays tiled, so it survives monitor changes, and a second window gets the whole screen back.

barWidget.description: Toggle the inset on this workspace, drag its size, jump between presets, adopt a size as the default, and pause everything while you share your screen.

schema.label: Show in the bar
schema.description: The icon alone by default. The size and preset variants trade bar width for detail the panel already shows. Hidden keeps Ichi running with nothing in the bar.

schema.label: Show on workspaces where Ichi is off
schema.description: Turn this off and the widget appears only where it is doing something.

schema.label: Left click
schema.description: Open panel matches Omarchy's other widgets, where right click is the quick toggle. Swapping these puts the toggle on left click instead.
